title.en: AI Product Weekly | From answers to actions, control surfaces matter

edition_label.zh: 周报试刊 · 本周尚未结束

intro.zh: 这是周一至周三晚的试刊，不是完整周报。我们从已刊日报候选回到原始来源，再加入开发者讨论、研究和公开调用数据。现阶段最有依据的判断是：执行入口在增加，但可靠性、权限与可观察性仍需单独验收；没有证据证明相应市场需求或收入同步增长。
intro.en: This pilot covers Monday through Wednesday evening, not a complete week. We revisited original sources behind daily candidates and added developer discussions, research, and public usage telemetry. The supported conclusion is narrow: execution surfaces are expanding, while reliability, permissions, and observability still need separate acceptance tests. Demand or revenue growth has not been established.
